name: Sakanyan Music Academy

reviews.text: We have been with Astrik for a few years now and the amount of Patience and professionalism that she has with her daughter is Phenomenal. We enjoy our lessons with her very much! We highly recommend her !!!
reviews.author: Isabelle K

reviews.text: In searching for a piano teacher for our kids, we wanted someone classically trained in piano who would focus on building a solid foundation of music theory and technique. We have seen tremendous progress in the past three years we have been taking lessons with Astghik. She works well with different ages and is the perfect combination of firm but patient. The kids love working with her and she has instilled an excitement for piano and music. We've recommended Astghik to many friends!
reviews.author: Theresa Lee

reviews.text: I recently started taking piano lessons from Ms. Sakanyan and I couldn't be happier with my experience. She is incredibly knowledgeable, patient and supportive. My technique has gotten so much better with just few sessions. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Mukul Srivastava

reviews.text: About 50 years after my last piano lesson, I resumed them with Astghik upon my retirement. What a joy! She is a talented pianist with infinite patience. Her observations, recommendations and teaching points are all spot on. I feared I'd give up after 1 or 2 lessons but this has been such a rewarding experience that I have no plans to stop now. If I had had her as a teacher when starting out as a teenager, I might not have stopped for those 50 years!
reviews.author: andre d.

reviews.text: I’ve been taking adult piano lessons for about 8 months with great progress. I’m already gearing up to perform in the winter recital! Astghik is knowledgeable, patient, and flexible. She has even helped me to think about the right instrument to practice at home. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ty Johnson
